lead_raw_text:
The orthorhombic Ba4Mg2Ti2O12 phase (reduced formula Ba2MgTiO6) crystallizes in space group Cbc2_1 (No. 15), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ti and Mg each in octahedral environments with six O neighbors, while Ba adopts a close-packed-like 12-neighbor arrangement. The O centers have two geometric neighbors, one Mg and one Ti. The polyhedra share edges between Mg and Ti octahedra, and face-sharing occurs between Ba polyhedra and both Mg and Ti octahedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
